name: UCW Explosion!: The Coming Out Party
no_appearances_reason: Character-level minting is deferred; this is also a joint GEWA/MVW/NPW co-broadcast, not GEWA's own card alone.
notes: A rotating co-broadcast between GEWA, Mohawk Valley Wrestling and Northeastern Pro Wrestling. Carries the wing's only surviving complete, dated 1997 title defence: Dr. Hate retains the Global Heavyweight Title over Red Raven, pinfall, 14:15.
